title: From Click Modeling to Offline and Off-Policy Evaluation in Carousel Recommendation
abstract: arXiv:2608.22022v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Carousel interfaces are widely used in modern recommendation systems. Unlike traditional interfaces that present a single ranked list, carousels simultaneously present several ranked lists to the user, as horizontally swipeable rows stacked on top of each other. In this design, the rankings are closely tied to the two-dimensional layout. Consequently, user behavior is shaped not only by item preference, but also by row organization, viewport constraints, and item context. This tight coupling between ranking and presentation complicates the interpretation of user feedback, introducing new challenges for recommendation evaluation.   My PhD research aims to address these challenges by rethinking how carousel clicks are modeled and how carousel recommendation policies can be evaluated from logged interaction data. translated_title: 从点击建模到轮播推荐中的离线和离策略评估
translated_abstract: 轮播界面在现代推荐系统中被广泛使用。与传统界面呈现单一排名列表不同，轮播界面同时向用户展示多个排名列表，作为可水平滑动的行堆叠在一起。在这种设计中，排名与二维布局紧密相关。因此，用户行为不仅受物品偏好影响，还受到行组织、视口约束和物品上下文的影响。排名与呈现之间的这种紧密耦合使得用户反馈的解释变得复杂，为推荐评估带来了新的挑战。我的博士研究旨在通过重新思考如何对轮播点击进行建模，以及如何从记录交互数据中评估轮播推荐策略来解决这些挑战。到目前为止，我研究了用户如何与轮播界面交互，并开发了一个优先考虑点击建模的设计框架。
tldr: 本研究针对轮播推荐中排名与二维布局耦合导致的评估难题，提出重新思考点击建模和从日志数据中评估推荐策略的方法，并开发了一个优先考虑点击建模的设计框架。
en_tdlr: This research addresses evaluation challenges in carousel recommendation caused by the coupling of ranking and 2D layout, proposing to rethink click modeling and policy evaluation from logged data, and developing a click model design framework that prioritizes these aspects.
